card.name: Spots just before photo- words
card.fires_on: Words and symbols that sit just before a word starting with photo-, or inside a word that leads to it, such as photosensitivity or lymphotropic. Often in all-caps warning text or in the middle of a longer word.

modes.label: All-caps warning text
modes.description: Verbs and linking words inside capitalized warning lines, where a photo- style word could come next.
modes.example: CAUTION: SILVER NITRATE<< IS>> A CAUSTIC SUBSTANCE.

modes.label: Inside longer words
modes.description: Pieces within a longer word or hyphenated term, such as lymphotropic or ampicillin.
modes.example: Definition of Human T-ly<<m>>photropic virus type I Human T

modes.label: Slash or colon before a term
modes.description: A separator right before a related term, as in photosensitivity and phototoxicity.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuing with photo- words and away from words starting with ot or otor.
card.plain: It fires on spots where a word like photosensitivity or photo-something could plausibly come next.
